author: iRecycler
title: In my opinion it is the best
content: Have tried a few apps like this. Most lately VOX. Flacbox has turned out as the best. In my opinion .True… it is somehow overpacked with functions I have no use for, but why not. It only shows the developer cares. Also appreciate frequent improvements. So… I am happy with it and can only recommend to everyone who owns a large hi-res music collection stored online. In my case up on Mega.
